## Description {#details}

The implementation of µTest++ makes extensive use of modern C++ features. With an emphasis on simplicity, µTest++ provides only a limited set of primitives for verifying expectations and assumptions.

No preprocessor macros are utilised; all primitives are implemented directly in C++.
